notes: lvx_notification_insert_message: logs 'Msg is NULL' under __func__ lvx_notification_insert_message (notification_manager). Copies the 88-byte caller struct (lvx_notification_init_message 0xC46CF74: malloc 88 + memcpy; NULL +0x1c/+0x20 icons default to /resource/app/notifications/default.bin / default_small.bin; +0x2c timestamp 0 is filled with CLOCK_REALTIME seconds), then insert_message 0xC472300 strdups every string (+0x0c,+0x10,+0x14,+0x18,+0x1c,+0x20,+0x24,+0x28; >512 bytes truncated with '...') into the uid-keyed lv_ll list 0x20070FEC and frees the temporary. Start-reminder byte is +0x4c (not +0x50 as in the .043 struct); +0x50 is the user_data pointer handed to the +0x44 detail callback. Returns free() residue, not a status. Runs uv_timer_start on timers bound to the app loop *0x20098D3C and dispatches event 27 synchronously, so call only from the UI/app-loop thread. Replaces the ensemble address 0xc16b154, which is bes_i2c_transfer. Supervisor platform service; static evidence only, device NOT_PROBED.
